title.zh: 修正的 fluidBW 特殊函数响应

summary: Evaluate the complete Gamma, Z and full R response contracts; four historical R method names share the corrected harmonic evaluator.

identity.relation: scaled Bessel Gamma, plasma Z and R response
identity.definition: RC=[R,d(bR)/db;Y dR/dY,Y d/dY(d(bR)/db)]. R=2Y/b sum_n>=1 n² Gamma_n/(Y²−n²); true poles fail.
identity.model: static isotropic Maxwellian plasma or its declared numerical approximation
identity.geometry: uniform background B along z; wavevector (kx,0,kz)
identity.coordinates: Cartesian SI; exp(i k·x−i ωt); signed gyrofrequency and radius
identity.boundary: homogeneous linear response; explicit resonances and analytic removable limits
assumptions: Listed-species linear response; electron-only case2 does not establish global charge neutrality or a self-consistent background equilibrium.

inputs.name: method
inputs.constraints: Gamman, Gammapn, zfun, RTAY, RASY, RINT or RYLA.

inputs.name: x
inputs.description: Integer Bessel order, Z argument or R argument Y.
inputs.shape: array for Gamma/Z; scalar for R
inputs.constraints: Integer real Gamma order; finite other arguments.

inputs.name: parameter
inputs.description: Bessel b or R b; unused for Z.
inputs.shape: array for Gamma; scalar for R; None for Z

outputs.name: value
outputs.description: Gamma/Gamma derivative or Z array, or full R response matrix.

preconditions: Pinned Linux amd64 GNU Octave7.3.0 runtime; OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=OMP_NUM_THREADS=1.
NumPy2.5.3 and SciPy1.18.1 Python3.12 scientific development runtime.
Finite integer harmonic orders for Gamma; parameter is required for Gamma and R, ignored for Z.
supported: Gamma_n=e^-b I_n(b) and its neighbor-identity derivative for integer n; finite scalar/array b.
Z(z) Weideman64, with erfcx on the imaginary axis; explicit overflow failure.
Full scalar R response for complex Y,b with tail and floating cancellation checks, bounded at 65536 terms; b=0 and Y=0 analytic limits.
excluded: No execution or fidelity claim for original Taylor/asymptotic/integral selector.

failure_semantics.invalid_input: ValueError for unknown controls, nonfinite/incoherent physical inputs, genuine poles or unrepresentable scientific response.
failure_semantics.runtime_failure: RuntimeError for unsupported/missing native runtime or abnormal native exit; subprocess timeout is explicit.
failure_semantics.nonconvergence: No nonlinear search candidate semantics in this API. Precision/tail failures are explicit ValueError; EM eigen residual and insufficient-selection failures are explicit ValueError where applicable.
failure_semantics.partial_results: Errors return no result; no failed or partial execution is presented as a successful output.
